description: Show the owner their KaiCalls dashboard right in the chat: an overview of calls, unheard voicemails, texts waiting on a reply, open to-dos and new leads; an inbox where they can reply to texts; recent calls; leads with their status; and a calls-per-day report over 7, 30 or 90 days. Use it when the owner asks to see their dashboard, their calls, their inbox, their leads, or how the line is doing. Read-only; replies and status changes the owner makes in it go through send_message and upsert_lead with the usual checks.

days.description: Period in days (default 7). The inbox covers at most the last 30.

view.description: Which tab to open first (default overview).

name: open_dashboard
title: Open KaiCalls Dashboard
